fatman.prompt: Create a standalone KALISTAR character PAINTING of FATMAN from METAL GEAR SOLID 2, a fan crossover illustration, portrait 4:5. The mandatory artistic family is the displayed approved Momo and Valazar Kalistar paintings: confident irregular brushstrokes and interlocking color planes, sculptural painted volumes, hierarchical lost-and-found edges, tactile patinated materials. The FACE, hands, clothing and background must all share this painted language. NOT photographic skin, NOT smooth CGI, NOT anime/manga, NOT a uniform mosaic/noise filter. Scene and moment: on Big Shell's Strut E rooftop HELIPAD during his boss confrontation in clear maritime daylight, Fatman glides to a menacing controlled stop on INLINE ROLLERBLADES, knees flexed, immense weight convincingly balanced over his wheels; upper body almost frontal with a slight three-quarter turn, shoulders broad. He is a MASSIVE VERY OBESE bald pale middle-aged man with a huge round torso and belly, small head relative to his padded body, narrow black sunglasses. His recognizable MGS2 olive/sage green BOMB-BLAST protective suit resembles a long massively padded heavy coat/apron reaching past knees, big chest padding, industrial buckles, thick insulated sleeves and several strapped equipment pouches. Crucial canonical silhouette: a HUGE RAISED rigid padded COLLAR rising to just under his nose, shielding chin, mouth and lower HALF OF HIS FACE, sides flaring up beside his head; no full face mask or helmet. His bald crown, sunglasses and contemptuous brow remain clearly visible above the collar. The coat opens sufficiently at the lower front to show two bulky protected shins and two black INLINE rollerblades, FOUR WHEELS IN A SINGLE ROW under each boot, real wheel-ground contact, not ice skates, not four-wheel quad skates. His expression and bearing communicate arrogant theatrical pleasure, a dangerous man delighted with his own performance, not a neutral mannequin. One gloved hand holds a compact closed rectangular fictional demolition-charge prop at his waist, other arm slightly extended for balance, several similar small sealed charge pouches attached to his chest/waist and one on the ground beside a distant crate. No exposed wiring, technical diagrams, labels or legible timer details. Avoid cartoon round bombs and explosives construction detail. Background restrained: broad worn helipad surface with a few partial landing stripes, a pair of dark green shipping crates, orange Big Shell safety rails, a low industrial structure, pale blue ocean horizon and large calm sky. No city, no clutter, no explosions or smoke obscuring silhouette. Natural directional sunlight with cool sea reflections, selectively brighter head/collar and hands. Full body including both skates readable, occupies about 78% image height, crown near x50% y16%, skates around y88%, central silhouette mostly x25%-75%; keep the bombs, head and wheels away from lateral card stat columns. A little lower-than-eye-level perspective conveys weight without cartoon distortion. Exactly one head, two arms/hands, two legs/skates. Keep him fat and bulky, not athletic or muscular. Painterly planes on exposed skin, large textured strokes on suit, quieter broad strokes in sky and distant background. One coherent narrative painting, no text, logos, watermark, interface, stats, border or card frame.

iterations.prompt: Create one standalone premium KALISTAR narrative PAINTING of DR. NAOMI HUNTER from the ORIGINAL METAL GEAR SOLID 1, portrait 4:5, fan crossover illustration. Match the displayed approved Momo and Valazar Kalistar PAINTED language: confident visible broken brushstrokes, sculpted warm/cool color planes in the FACE and hands, grouped painted hair, textured worn surfaces, controlled sharp and lost edges. NOT photographic, NOT smooth CGI, NOT anime or manga, NOT a uniform noise or mosaic filter. Official MGS1 identity: adult woman in her late twenties, warm light-brown/tan complexion, intelligent dark eyes, elegant but grounded face, dark brown shoulder-length hair swept BACK from forehead in loose soft waves, not short MGS4 bob, no glasses. Costume from MGS1 official art: slightly worn WHITE thigh-length medical lab coat, sleeves rolled to forearms, restrained dark brown/charcoal collared blouse underneath, dark fitted knee-length pencil skirt, plain dark low heels, small hospital identification badge with no legible writing. Professional and non-suggestive, not a glamorous pinup or a plunging neckline. Moment: in the military mission-support medical room during the Shadow Moses operation, she has paused over a large bound medical/research BOOK at a waist-height desk after hearing worrying news over her earpiece. One hand steadies an open page and spine, the other gently touches the small communication earpiece; she looks to an off-camera colleague with a restrained conflicted expression, worried compassion and a guarded secret behind composed eyes. BOOK is the visual equivalent of the game Grimoire weapon, not a medieval sorceress prop: large dark burgundy cloth/leather-bound medical reference, visibly solid binding, pages physically attached at one central gutter and inside both covers, resting on the desk, anatomically plausible hands. Subtle medical context: a small closed red-capped specimen vial in a rack, a few notes, a 1990s CRT monitor with abstract dim green traces, painted gray-green naval bulkhead and practical desk lamp. Do not draw readable data, formulas, technical medical instructions, holographic DNA, magic circles, blood splashes, vampire features or occult energy. Her Blood crystal is a gameplay choice, represented here only by a restrained burgundy book accent, not supernatural body effects. Suggest a submarine/military support room, NOT Naomi physically inside Shadow Moses's weapons hangar and NOT a modern glossy hospital. Head and primary action in central band x28%-72%, head at y18%, book and hands around y50-60%, three-quarter/full figure with skirt and lower legs visible, enough space above hair and below shoes. Desk occupies lower left side without covering her face or upper torso, book kept central and readable despite future lateral stat columns. Windowless room, warm desk-lamp illumination and cooler overhead spill shape the painted face; background subdued, a few meaningful objects rather than dense equipment. Paint the skin with deliberate planes and bristle marks while retaining human anatomy and emotion. Two hands, two arms, one head. No text, logos, watermark, stats, UI or card border.

Edit target image 1: Naomi MGS1 in the support medical room. Style references 2 and 3 are Kalistar Momo and Valazar, use only their painted color-plane treatment. Preserve Naomi's adult face identity, concerned expression, brown swept-back wavy hair, white lab coat, dark blouse and skirt, earphone gesture, medical room and motivated lighting. Correct the OPEN MEDICAL BOOK on the desk: current leather exterior appears like two vertical boxes/spines facing us, anatomically impossible. Rebuild as ONE ordinary open hardcover volume resting flat on the desktop: BOTH burgundy cover boards lie underneath the cream page blocks, each board only a few millimetres thick. Pages form two shallow slightly curved wedges connected at ONE central gutter/spine, a natural broad shallow V seen from above; foreground edge shows cream PAPER edges, NOT tall upright leather walls. One coherent binding, one spine, no detached floating leaves, not two books joined together. Her supporting hand rests naturally on the right open page. Make it a substantial scientific reference book, no glowing glyphs or readable text. Refine face/skin/hair brushwork to match Momo and Valazar's clearly painted warm/cool planes, no smooth photographic complexion; maintain natural anatomy and expression. Keep other composition unchanged as far as possible but output a portrait FOUR-TO-FIVE canvas with extra breathing room above her hair and below her shoes, full body entirely visible inside central x28%-72%. Important for card window cropping: hair begins no higher than y12%, shoes end around y89%. Extend the unobtrusive surrounding room rather than zooming into her. No frame, stats, interface, logos or watermark.
